- The function must be named `formatAdminReport` and take one parameter `admin`: an object with `name`, `email`, `lastLogin`.
- The banner is exactly 40 `=` characters (`"=".repeat(40)`).
- The output is a multi-line string with this exact layout (lines joined by `\n`):
  - banner
  - `Report for <name> <<email>>`
  - banner
  - `Last login: <lastLogin>`
  - banner
- The banner layout must match the user report exactly; only the body line differs (`Last login: <lastLogin>` in place of the visits line).
- The function must be exported, and `formatUserReport` must remain working and exported.
